verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical, and they share the same flaws. The brush-stroke shape that sits behind the title in the original has been moved up and floats alone above the cream jar, so it no longer frames the text. 'Spa Utopia' and the subtitle sit on top of the busy photo: they collide with the amber dropper at the left edge and the green leaves on the right. The subtitle 'Weekly SPA items review' is nearly as large as the headline, which flattens the hierarchy. The only difference is the shade of the floating stroke (slightly darker in A, paler in B), and it doesn't make either one better.
